chunks: He said, 'By God, you had almost ruined me.'

key_terms.لَتُرْدِينِ: To ruin me / lead me to destruction

ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'you had almost ruined me' signify in Quranic context?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase is often contextualized within the narrative of Prophet Yusuf (Joseph), where his brothers' persuasion nearly led to his spiritual or physical ruin, illustrating the potency of persuasive speech. It serves as a reminder of the delicate balance between human agency and divine protection against the subtle influences of others.
